title: Ceyhan Rising
summary:
Ceyhan Rising
Bereft of traditional Iraqi Kirkuk crude oil barrels by the US invasion of Iraq, liftings from Ceyhan withered from their bustling activity of the late 1990's. Despite the continuing unreliability of the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline, this port's lifts are exhibiting signs of rebounding lifting activity. Key to this recovery is last year's introduction of Azeri crude oil to world markets through inauguration of the Baku- Tbilisi-Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline (see Poten Weekly Opinion June 9, 2006).

children.title: Pushing Barrels
children.summary: The nearly 1,100 mile BTC pipeline began filling its 10 million barrel working inventory in May 2005. Eleven months later, Ceyhan's first cargo of Azeri crude oil was loaded onto a tanker late last June.
